answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks sybil farming. Claiming a slot locks 60 coins and issues an opal receipt. Delivery refunds it; faking work or abandoning it burns it. Forging 1,000 hollow identities costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 coins against a monthly pool of 30,000; fraud costs twice what it earns. A sybil farm is an island: its fakes trade only with each other, so the shared deposit graph flags the cluster. Honest agents pay once and keep earnings.
